title: Partner review tracker — AWS & GCP Marketplace listing refresh
content:
Context
- This tracker consolidates AWS + GCP partner review feedback for the Marketplace Listing Refresh (Hosted/Dedicated/Private SKUs + add-ons), including iteration history, required changes, and owner/status.
- Source of truth for “what changed since last submission” to reduce partner review churn.

How to use
- Add partner feedback as individual rows (one row per actionable item). If partner feedback is bundled, split into multiple rows with shared submission iteration.
- Use Status values: Open | In progress | Ready for resubmission | Submitted | Approved | Deferred | Blocked.
- Use “Evidence/Link” for the exact artifact the partner reviewer will validate (docs URL, PDF, screenshot filename, PR link).

--------------------------------------------
TAB: AWS Marketplace — Review items (action tracker)
(Columns are pipe-delimited for copy/paste into Sheets)

ID | Cloud | Offer/Listing | Submission iteration | Submitted to partner (date) | Partner reviewer / channel | Feedback category | Feedback summary | Required change (what exactly) | Redwood owner | Target due | Status | Resubmitted? (date) | Evidence / link | Notes / decisions
AWS-01 | AWS | Public listing (Redwood Inference) | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Listing copy | “Avoid unqualified superlatives; clarify what ‘unified runtime’ means.” | Replace “fastest” language with benchmarkable claims; add concrete bullets for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. | Soojin Lee | 2026-01-20 | Approved | 2026-01-21 | drive:aws-listing-copy-draft-v3 | Copy updated per PMM guidelines; remove “best-in-class”.
AWS-02 | AWS | Public listing | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Security / compliance | Security overview needs explicit shared responsibility statement for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. | Add “Shared responsibility model” section; explicitly state Redwood responsibilities vs customer responsibilities (networking, IAM, keys where applicable). | Naomi Feldman | 2026-01-24 | Submitted | 2026-01-29 | confluence:marketplace-security-documentation-pack | Language reviewed by GRC; keep SOC2 statement precise (“SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA”).
AWS-03 | AWS | Public listing | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Data handling | Clarify logging/retention defaults for prompts/outputs; reviewers asked “Do you store customer prompts by default?” | Add retention table: prompt/output retention default, configurable retention for enterprise, and how to request changes; link to retention page. | Dr. Aisha Rahman | 2026-01-26 | Submitted | 2026-01-29 | confluence:marketplace-data-handling-and-retention | Keep wording consistent across listing + FAQ + security packet.
AWS-04 | AWS | Public listing | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Audit logs | “Audit logging capabilities should be described with event examples and export options.” | Include a short “What’s logged” list (login, API key creation, model changes, org provisioning, entitlement checks) + export mechanisms (SIEM) and retention. | Marcus Lin | 2026-01-26 | Submitted | 2026-01-29 | confluence:audit-logs-for-marketplace-customers | Ensure we don’t overpromise “all API requests logged” (we log admin + control-plane events; request-level logs via customer instrumentation/tracing).
AWS-05 | AWS | Public listing | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Visual assets | Need console screenshots at required resolution; include at least one onboarding flow screen and one cost/latency dashboard. | Produce 5 screenshots: onboarding entrypoint, API key screen, usage dashboard, model rollout screen, audit log view; ensure branding and no PII. | Alicia Perez | 2026-01-22 | Approved | 2026-01-23 | drive:listing-screenshots-and-asset-checklist | Use staging environment; scrub org names.
AWS-06 | AWS | Metering | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner portal notes | Billing dimensions | Dimension labels must map cleanly to offer; partner flagged that “Hosted-Requests” is ambiguous (token vs request). | Update dimension names to token-based where possible; confirm “per 1K tokens” semantics match internal meters; update mapping doc. | Cole Summers | 2026-02-01 | Approved | 2026-02-02 | github:redwood/pr-19874 | Follow-up from ENG triage on mismatch (see Slack eng 1769621188).
AWS-07 | AWS | Onboarding flow | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Entitlement | Reviewer asked for clear “subscription -> entitlement -> org provisioning” steps & expected timing. | Add “How it works” section with timeline expectations; include retry guidance for entitlement propagation delays and support contact. | Alex Martinez | 2026-02-05 | Submitted | 2026-02-06 | github:redwood-docs/pr-3421 | Add explicit callout: entitlement can take up to ~15 minutes; if >30 minutes, contact support.
AWS-08 | AWS | Private offers | Round 1 | 2026-01-14 | AWS Partner team (sync) | Commercial | Add private offer language: committed spend, support plan attachment, and what changes in-product (quotas/SLA). | Provide a “Private offer FAQ” internal + buyer-facing snippet; align with finance guardrails. | Jordan Blake | 2026-02-12 | In progress |  | drive:aws-private-offer-template-notes | Finance review pending; avoid committing to specific discount levels in public docs.

ID | Cloud | Offer/Listing | Submission iteration | Submitted to partner (date) | Partner reviewer / channel | Feedback category | Feedback summary | Required change (what exactly) | Redwood owner | Target due | Status | Resubmitted? (date) | Evidence / link | Notes / decisions
GCP-01 | GCP | Listing (Redwood Inference) | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner team (sync) | Artifacts checklist | Partner needs explicit list of required artifacts + final public URLs (security + onboarding). | Provide final URL list with redirects; ensure no broken links; confirm what is public vs gated. | Elliot Price | 2026-02-06 | Approved | 2026-02-07 | github:redwood-docs/pr-3422 | Docs redirects tracked separately (INT-771).
GCP-02 | GCP | Billing integration | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner team (sync) | Billing dimensions | Partner asked to validate mapping between Redwood meters and GCP billing dimensions; requested example invoice line items. | Update mapping table; add example invoice lines; confirm rounding rules and any minimums. | Emily Stone | 2026-02-10 | In progress |  | confluence:gcp-marketplace-sku-and-billing-dimensions | Waiting on billing export sample from finance ops.
GCP-03 | GCP | Listing copy | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner team (sync) | Claims | “Dedicated capacity” wording should not imply single-tenant hardware unless guaranteed. | Update copy: “reserved capacity pools with data isolation controls” and specify optional single-tenant terms only in private offers / order form. | Soojin Lee | 2026-01-22 | Approved | 2026-01-23 | drive:gcp-listing-copy-draft-v2 | PMM confirmed compliant language.
GCP-04 | GCP | Security | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner team (sync) | Encryption / keys | Partner wants clearer statement: encryption at rest/in transit, and KMS options (Hosted vs Private). | Add short KMS section with “customer-managed keys supported for Private deployments” + standard encryption posture; link to packet. | Marcus Lin | 2026-01-28 | Submitted | 2026-01-29 | confluence:marketplace-security-documentation-pack | Keep AWS KMS vs GCP CMEK terms separated; avoid vendor-specific promises in shared doc.
GCP-05 | GCP | Onboarding | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner team (sync) | Provisioning | Partner expects explicit “Entitlement validation screen” and error copy for invalid subscription/expired entitlement. | Implement console marketplace entrypoint + error codes; add screenshot to docs. | Chloe Martin | 2026-02-08 | Submitted | 2026-02-09 | github:redwood/pr-19876 | Error states: ENTITLEMENT_NOT_FOUND, ENTITLEMENT_PENDING, SUBSCRIPTION_MISMATCH.
GCP-06 | GCP | Compliance posture | Round 1 | 2026-01-16 | GCP Partner portal notes | SOC2/ISO | Reviewer asked for “evidence pointers” rather than full reports in listing attachments. | Provide “Evidence available on request” statement + link to gated security packet request process; include control summary. | Olga Petrov | 2026-02-01 | Approved | 2026-02-02 | drive:security-docs-publication-plan | GRC confirmed we can publish control summary, not full report.

--------------------------------------------
Open items / watchouts (as of 2026-02-20)
- GCP-02 (billing mapping + example invoice lines) is the current pacing item for GCP submission completeness.
- AWS-08 (private offer language) needs finance/legal sign-off before we provide partner-facing template details.
- Ensure all marketplace-facing security claims stay consistent with latest Security packet; any copy edits must route to Naomi Feldman + Olga Petrov for review.

Notes to self (for next partner sync)
- Bring: final “How it works” diagram screenshot + exact docs URLs (with redirects verified) + one-page dimension mapping summary.
- Ask partner teams: preferred attachment format (PDF vs URL) for security overview and whether they want a separate data flow diagram per deployment mode.
